
## Download

| Your PC | Installer (recommended) | Portable (no install, runs from any folder or USB stick) |
|---|---|---|
| **Most PCs** (64-bit Intel/AMD) | [Kino-Setup-x64.exe](https://github.com/Sriharan-S/kino-enhanced-windows/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/Kino-Setup-x64.exe) | [Kino-Portable-x64.zip](https://github.com/Sriharan-S/kino-enhanced-windows/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/Kino-Portable-x64.zip) |
| **ARM** (Snapdragon / Copilot+ PCs) | [Kino-Setup-arm64.exe](https://github.com/Sriharan-S/kino-enhanced-windows/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/Kino-Setup-arm64.exe) | [Kino-Portable-arm64.zip](https://github.com/Sriharan-S/kino-enhanced-windows/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/Kino-Portable-arm64.zip) |
| **Older 32-bit** Windows | [Kino-Setup-x86.exe](https://github.com/Sriharan-S/kino-enhanced-windows/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/Kino-Setup-x86.exe) | [Kino-Portable-x86.zip](https://github.com/Sriharan-S/kino-enhanced-windows/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/Kino-Portable-x86.zip) |

Not sure? Use **x64**. To check: Settings → System → About → *System type*.

- **Installer:** installs for your account only (no admin rights), adds Kino to the Start menu and *Settings → Apps*
  (uninstall there), and opens `kino://` invite links. Installing a newer version upgrades in place.
- **Portable:** unzip and run `Kino\Kino.exe`. Everything it stores stays in its `Data` folder.
- Windows 10 2004 or later. Windows may show *"Windows protected your PC"* because the app isn't code-signed yet:
  choose **More info → Run anyway**.
- Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
